title: English III: Grammar, Voice & Narration
desc: Tenses, voice, narration, prepositions and articles

questions.q: Fill in the blank: He ___ to Lahore yesterday.
questions.e: The past simple is needed with 'yesterday'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: I have been living here ___ 2015.
questions.e: 'Since' is used with a point in time; 'for' with a period.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: I have been living here ___ five years.
Fill in the blank: Each of the girls ___ a prize.
Fill in the blank: Ten kilometres ___ a long distance.
questions.e: Distances are treated as a single unit.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: He is senior ___ me.
questions.e: Senior, junior, superior and inferior take 'to'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She is good ___ mathematics.
Fill in the blank: He is fond ___ music.
Fill in the blank: She is afraid ___ snakes.
Fill in the blank: The book is ___ the table.
Fill in the blank: He died ___ cancer.
questions.e: 'Died of' for a disease; 'died by' a weapon.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She was born ___ 1995.
questions.e: 'In' with years; 'on' with dates; 'at' with time.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: The meeting is ___ 10 a.m.
Fill in the blank: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
Fill in the blank: He apologised ___ his mistake.
Fill in the blank: I prefer tea ___ coffee.
Fill in the blank: He insisted ___ paying the bill.
Fill in the blank: She is married ___ a doctor.
Fill in the blank: ___ umbrella is useful in the rain.
Fill in the blank: He is ___ honest man.
questions.e: 'Honest' begins with a silent h, so it uses 'an'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She is ___ European student.
Fill in the blank: He is ___ M.A. in English.
Fill in the blank: ___ Sun rises in the east.
Change into the passive voice: 'He writes a letter.'
o: A letter was written by him.
A letter is being written by him.
A letter is written by him.
A letter has been written by him.
questions.e: Simple present active becomes 'is/are + past participle'.

questions.q: Change into the passive voice: 'They are playing football.'
o: Football was being played by them.
Football is being played by them.
Football has been played by them.
questions.e: Present continuous becomes 'is/are being + past participle'.

questions.q: Change into the passive voice: 'She has completed the work.'
o: The work was completed by her.
The work has been completed by her.
The work is completed by her.
The work had been completed by her.
questions.e: Present perfect becomes 'has/have been + past participle'.

questions.q: Change into the passive voice: 'Open the door.'
questions.e: Imperative sentences use 'Let ... be + past participle'.

questions.q: Change into active voice: 'The poem was written by Iqbal.'
questions.e: Simple past passive becomes simple past active.

questions.q: Change into indirect speech: She said, 'I will come tomorrow.'
o: She said that she would come the next day.
She said that she will come tomorrow.
She said that she would come tomorrow.
She said that I would come the next day.

questions.q: Change into indirect speech: He said to me, 'What is your name?'
o: He asked me what my name was.
He asked me what is my name.
He said me what my name was.
He asked me that what my name was.
questions.e: Wh- questions do not use 'that' in reported speech.

questions.q: Change into indirect speech: She said, 'Alas! I am ruined.'
o: She said that alas she was ruined.
She told alas she is ruined.
She exclaimed with sorrow that she was ruined.
She exclaimed that she is ruined.

The plural of 'criterion' is:
The plural of 'mother-in-law' is:
questions.e: The main noun takes the plural form.

questions.q: The comparative of 'good' is:
The superlative of 'bad' is:

questions.e: The word has double 'c' and double 'm'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
questions.e: The subjunctive 'were' is used in unreal conditions.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She sings ___ than her sister.
Fill in the blank: He was ___ tired to walk.
Fill in the blank: Please wait ___ I come back.
questions.e: 'Until' marks the end of a period.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: She has lived here ___ ten years.
Fill in the blank: He is the ___ student in the class.
Fill in the blank: I look forward ___ you.
Fill in the blank: She is interested ___ painting.
Fill in the blank: He has been absent ___ Monday.
Fill in the blank: I am looking ___ my keys.
Fill in the blank: They are proud ___ their son.
Fill in the blank: He is accused ___ theft.
Fill in the blank: The sun ___ in the east.
questions.e: A universal truth takes the simple present.
